investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on a suspicious domain that appears to impersonate the Vitalis patient portal. The scanned URL leads to a login page on vitalis-portal-security.com and resolves to IP 195.178.110.15. The domain is newly registered (2 days old) through NameCheap, Inc., and the combination of a brand logo on a login page of a new domain indicates potential phishing or impersonation; this is high priority due to credential theft risk.
